title: Still bent after trying so many things
text: Still bent after trying so many things. I really want to love these... They are sturdy, I love the color, they are thick/durable. But no matter what I try, they are bent out of shape from being shipped. I event tried wetting them and stuffing blankets in there to make them take the correct shape, to no avail. I mean, I am not sending them back, I will probably put them in a closet somewhere, out of sight. But if they could figure out a way to ship them without flattening them, this product would be 5 stars!

product_metadata.title: YOUDENOVA Cotton Rope Cube Storage Baskets, 13x13 Round Woven Baskets for Storage with Handles 2 Pack, Modern Decorative Storage Bins Décor Baskets for 13 inch Cube Storage Shelves, Mix Grey
features: 【Perfect Size】: YOUDENOVA 13” cube baskets set is a fascinating choice for 13inch and larger cube storage shelves. These coiled rope baskets’ circular shape fits well into square shelf units, adding a modern & unique flair to your home. Of course, they also look fantastic on the floor, bookcase, end table, and more.

【Natural Material】: The baskets are made of high-quality cotton rope, which is 100% recyclable and renewable. They are non-irritate and have no chemical residue, and are always ready for your and your baby’s intimate clothing.

【Sturdy Enough to Stand on Its Own】: Different from other's floppy rope baskets, YOUDENOVA sewed each rope tightly together by threads, making them stand on their own even when it's empty. Compared to ordinary fabric cubes, our woven rope cubes are far more sturdy and durable. They will last for years of use.

【Portable & Collapsible Storage】: 13x13x13 rope bins is a nice home for items that you use frequently but don't necessarily want to set out on their own (towels, clothes, blanket, brush, skincare, noodles, snacks, etc.) With the rope handles, it’s easy to take the baskets off the shelf and carry it from room to room. Also, they are foldable when not in use to save space.

【Machine Washable】: When they get dirty, you can wash them with mild detergent by washing machine or your own hands. Please do not place them in the dryer. Let them dry out in the sun, and remove the creases with an iron.
